status_legend.code-exists: Python reference source already in repository; UI does not yet exist
status_legend.specification-only: manifest or design exists; no runnable demonstration in current source
status_legend.reference-specification: published engineering plan and calculations; browser simulation to be authored

demos.title: Crystal consumption and replay
demos.input: A consented fictional usage episode and versioned manifest
demos.output: Hash verification, replay receipt, MemoryBank retrieval result and held-out question marker
demos.proof: Demo source and passing CI; no transfer to living neurons

demos.title: WindBus traffic inspector
demos.input: Timestamped, authenticated simulated task and observation events
demos.output: Routes, typed envelopes, rejected duplicates/expired events, audit log
demos.proof: Link a recorded or directly executed software test; no biological channel implied

demos.title: Lotus developmental decisions
demos.input: Expected performance, protected skill delta and proposed digital action
demos.output: STAGE_DIGITAL, HOLD, VETO or UNRESOLVED with reason
demos.proof: Digital decision only, no feed/chemical/stimulation controls

demos.title: Soil environmental observation console
demos.input: Synthetic timestamped temperature or fake sensor frame
demos.output: Freshness check, duplicate/authentication failure, fault state, review receipt
demos.proof: Always show SYNTHETIC, no real measurements/automated care

demos.title: The Last Cat: Metroidvania StarChip
demos.input: World seed, abilities, key/lock dependencies, room targets, difficulty profile
demos.output: Procedural map topology, path validity, room entry gates, alternative-seed comparison, nonplayable preview or playable engine when actually built
demos.proof: Must run a deterministic graph validator before declaring a seed playable

demos.title: Music by genre: AHD/ARD score explorer
demos.input: Genre, tempo, meter, key, tension curve, allowed instruments
demos.output: Original MIDI/score event model, tension/interruption trace, pattern relation, generated excerpt if properly owned
demos.proof: No playback of unlicensed music, no claim of learned biological composer

demos.title: Research Scientist: hypothesis and evidence
demos.input: A narrow scientific question and named source evidence set
demos.output: Competing hypotheses, candidate metrics, falsifiers, source references, risk/extrapolation label
demos.proof: No inventing citations, no operational wet-lab recipe, no simulated experiment called real

demos.title: Book MicroCrystal to digital memory
demos.input: Short public-domain or WDS-owned teaching text with rights
demos.output: Source-linked Bread lessons, recall questions, withheld exercise and digital replay/manifest
demos.proof: Accessed text vs trained knowledge clearly distinguished; never imply peptide education

demos.title: Power and supervisory bandwidth lab
demos.input: Explicitly hypothetical channel count, sample rate, bytes/sample and interface choice
demos.output: Data-rate and storage-budget computation with provenance and invalid-input warnings
demos.proof: No fabricated power draw, electrical energy not inferred from current-squared without voltage
